2610.13296.title: PRIME: Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling Enhancement for Structured Document Retrieval-Real
2610.13296.paper_summary: High-precision retrieval over external knowledge bases is essential for LLM agents to operate effectively. However, existing Information Retrieval (IR) research primarily optimizes query-side retrievers (e.g., ColBERT, BGE) and generators (e.g., Self-RAG, GraphRAG), while reducing corpus-side representation to chunking. This leaves index-side quality an underexplored lever. We propose Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling & Enhancement (PRIME), an index-side optimization framework built on two complementary tracks: an LLM-driven Semantic Restructuring (SR) track that transforms long documents into structured, information-dense sections, and a deterministic Metadata Synthesis (MS) and Hierarchical Retrieval (HR) track that extracts semantic anchors and heading structure for coarse-to-fine section retrieval. Our evaluations show that deterministic metadata matches structure-aware chunking's retrieval quality while cutting embedding computation by 45.8 $\times$ and index vector count by 22.4 $\times$. On top of these gains, Semantic Restructuring (SR) further improves Answer-F1 by 13.7% in full deployment, with characterized quality-fidelity-cost trade-offs. Across QASPER, BRIGHT, and NFCorpus, we further characterize three qualitative regimes that determine whether index-side optimization helps or degrades retrieval, while showing that these index-side effects are neutralized under a strong reranker.
2610.13296.paper_summary_zh: 高精度檢索外部知識庫對於大型語言模型代理有效運作至關重要。<lb/>然而，現有的信息檢索（IR）研究主要優化查詢端的檢索器（例如，ColBERT、BGE）和生成器（例如，Self-RAG、GraphRAG），而將語料庫端的表示簡化為分塊。<lb/>這使得索引端的質量成為一個未被充分探索的槓桿。<lb/>我們提出了預檢索索引建模與增強（PRIME），這是一個基於兩個互補路徑的索引端優化框架：一個由大型語言模型驅動的語義重構（SR）路徑，將長文檔轉換為結構化、信息密集的部分；另一個是確定性元數據綜合（MS）和分層檢索（HR）路徑，提取語義錨點和標題結構以進行粗到細的部分檢索。<lb/>我們的評估顯示，確定性元數據的檢索質量與結構感知的分塊相匹配，同時將嵌入計算減少了 45.8 $\times$，索引向量數量減少了 22.4 $\times$。<lb/>在這些增益之上，語義重構（SR）在全面部署中進一步提高了答案-F1 指標 13.7%，並具有特徵化的質量-忠實度-成本權衡。<lb/>在 QASPER、BRIGHT 和 NFCorpus 中，我們進一步特徵化了三種定性範疇，決定索引端優化是否有助於或降低檢索效果，同時顯示這些索引端的影響在強大的重排序器下被中和。
